# Desmond Hiew

> Full-stack developer building web and mobile products with TypeScript, React and Node.

Desmond Hiew (also known as Kian Hooi Hiew / kianhooi.hiew) is a full-stack
developer. This site is a personal portfolio with a CLI-style home page.
